conventions.rule: Pass = 50% in written AND 50% in oral/practical AND 50% aggregate, at the same sitting; Islamic/Pak Studies 33%. "Distinction" = 85%+ in a subject (only if all subjects passed together).
conventions.formHandling: Ask results as "Marks obtained / total" (or Percentage) per Professional year.
conventions.source: UHS statutes, First Professional MBBS (uhs.edu.pk/downloads/1stprofmbbs.pdf) and Fourth Professional (uhs.edu.pk/downloads/4thdprofmbbs.pdf) - retrieved 2026-10-21

conventions.rule: Passing grade 50%; assessment 10% internal + 90% UHS external.
conventions.source: UHS Statutes & Regulations for Post-RN B.Sc Nursing (2-year) Examinations (uhs.edu.pk/downloads/nursingregulations_2year.pdf) - retrieved 2026-10-21

conventions.rule: Minimum pass 50% in theory and 50% in practical for each subject.
conventions.formHandling: Marks or Percentage per Professional year.
conventions.source: KMU examination rules as published by Khyber Girls Medical College (kgmc.edu.pk/page/Examination-Rules) - retrieved 2026-10-21

conventions.body: KMU (semester programmes, e.g. BSN, DPT, AHS)
conventions.formHandling: Applicants enter SGPA/CGPA; letter grades use the HEC list. Table is UNVERIFIED (third-party).
conventions.source: Third-party KMU CGPA calculator (gpatocgpacalculator.pk/kmu-cgpa-calculator) - NOT an official KMU source; verify against the KMU transcript legend

conventions.rule: PNMC does not publish its own letter scale - BSN results come on the awarding university's HEC-style transcript. PNMC rule: pass each course with at least 60% and keep CGPA 2.5+ to progress; CGPA 2.0 or below with a failed course = probation.
conventions.formHandling: Use SGPA/CGPA with the HEC letter list; admin flag if a nursing course % < 60 or CGPA < 2.5.
conventions.source: PNMC regulations "Establishment of Nursing Educational Institutions & Degree Programs 2021" (pnmc.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/ESTABLISHMENT-NURSING-EDUCATIONAL-INSTITUTIONS-DEGREE-PROGRAMS-2021.pdf) - pass rule as summarised in search results; verify wording in the PDF. PNMC curriculum page (pnmc.gov.pk/nursing-curriculum/) - retrieved 2026-10-21

conventions.rule: Results are issued as marks/percentage per year by the provincial nursing examination board.
conventions.formHandling: Ask Marks obtained / total or Percentage.
